I'm an M.S. in Business Analytics candidate at Baruch College (expected 2026) with 4+ years in sales analytics and revenue operations.

My work sits where sales strategy meets data: incentive compensation, pipeline reporting, CRM optimization, and self-serve dashboards that let sales teams answer their own questions. I've done this at RNDC in wine and spirits distribution and at JTI in consumer goods.

I'm PL-300 certified in Power BI and hold Salesforce credentials. This site collects my coursework for STA 9750.

    install.packages("leaflet")
    stopifnot(require("leaflet"))
}

baruch_longitude <- -73.98333
baruch_latitude  <- +40.74028

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, zoom=17) |>
  addPopups(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude,
            "M.S. in Business Analytics at <b>Baruch College</b>")
